take_homes: What you tell the AI first changes every answer after it, like salmon instead of pasta. So give it real background.
You can save that background in a file, so you don't type it every time. Could work for my reporting.
The AI is too nice about its own work. I check it with what I know, like if the depot names are wrong.

misconception.why: A saved background file for reports sounds like operations, not a customer chatbot. But every example was a personal website, so I'm not sure yet.

one_line: The salmon example was good and I made a website, but it was all about my LinkedIn. Show me a depot shift plan and I would care.
